description: 30 held-out business questions over the enterprise demo schema. They were written after the value-grounding work and did not participate in its design, so they measure generalisation rather than tuning. Data is synthetic enterprise demo data.

cases.question: 华东区域已完成的订单有多少单
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM enterprise_orders WHERE region = '华东' AND status = 'completed'

cases.question: 金融行业客户的订单明细金额合计是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.line_amount), 2) AS total FROM order_items oi JOIN enterprise_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN enterprise_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.industry = '金融'

cases.question: 各区域各渠道分别有多少订单
cases.gold_sql: SELECT region, channel, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM enterprise_orders GROUP BY region, channel

cases.question: 各订单状态占全部订单的比例是多少（用 0 到 1 的小数表示）
cases.gold_sql: SELECT status, ROUND(COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enterprise_orders), 4) AS share FROM enterprise_orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC

cases.question: 已完成订单占全部订单的比例是多少（用 0 到 1 的小数表示）
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS completed_share FROM enterprise_orders

cases.question: 按订单金额分三档（5 万以下、5 万到 15 万、15 万以上）统计订单数，三档分别标记为 low、mid、high
cases.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN total_amount < 50000 THEN 'low' WHEN total_amount < 150000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'high' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM enterprise_orders GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket ASC

cases.question: 2026 年的订单一共有多少单
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM enterprise_orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01'

cases.question: 有多少订单没有关联客户
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM enterprise_orders WHERE customer_id IS NULL

cases.question: 有多少客户一个订单都没有
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM enterprise_customers c LEFT JOIN enterprise_orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL

cases.question: 下过订单的客户一共有多少个
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM enterprise_orders

cases.question: 订单明细的平均折扣率是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(discount), 4) AS avg_discount FROM order_items

cases.question: 按售价分三档（500 元以下、500 到 5000 元、5000 元以上）统计商品数，三档分别标记为 low、mid、high
cases.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN list_price < 500 THEN 'low' WHEN list_price < 5000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'high' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket ASC

cases.question: 各入职年份分别有多少员工
cases.gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(hire_date) AS hire_year, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees GROUP BY YEAR(hire_date) ORDER BY hire_year ASC

cases.question: 按评分区间（3 分以下、3 到 4 分、4 分以上）统计供应商数，三档分别标记为 low、mid、high
cases.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN rating < 3 THEN 'low' WHEN rating < 4 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'high' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM suppliers GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket ASC

cases.question: 各支付方式在各支付状态下分别有多少笔
cases.gold_sql: SELECT method, status, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments GROUP BY method, status

cases.question: 2025 年每个月的退款笔数占当月支付笔数的比例是多少（月份用 1 到 12 的整数表示）
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MONTH(paid_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS refund_ratio FROM payments WHERE paid_date >= '2025-01-01' AND paid_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(paid_date) ORDER BY month ASC

cases.question: 各仓库的可用库存合计和补货点合计分别是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT warehouse, SUM(available_qty) AS available_total, SUM(reorder_point) AS reorder_total FROM inventory GROUP BY warehouse ORDER BY warehouse ASC

cases.question: 按缺口从大到小取前 3 个仓库，缺口相同时按仓库名升序
cases.gold_sql: SELECT warehouse, SUM(reorder_point - available_qty) AS gap FROM inventory WHERE available_qty < reorder_point GROUP BY warehouse ORDER BY gap DESC, warehouse ASC LIMIT 3

cases.question: 名称里包含“科技”的供应商有多少家
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM suppliers WHERE name LIKE '%科技%'

cases.question: 2025 年之前注册的客户有多少个
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM enterprise_customers WHERE signup_date < '2025-01-01'

cases.question: 按 id 升序取前 5 个客户，把客户编码和名称用短横线拼接展示
cases.gold_sql: SELECT CONCAT(customer_code, '-', name) AS label FROM enterprise_customers ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 客户行业名称去重后统一转成大写
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(industry) AS industry_upper FROM enterprise_customers ORDER BY industry_upper ASC

cases.question: 订单金额在 5 万到 15 万之间的订单有多少单
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM enterprise_orders WHERE total_amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 150000

cases.question: 各行业客户的订单明细金额分别是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.industry, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_amount), 2) AS total FROM order_items oi JOIN enterprise_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN enterprise_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.industry ORDER BY c.industry ASC

cases.question: 各部门月度人力成本占全公司人力成本的比例是多少（用 0 到 1 的小数表示）
cases.gold_sql: SELECT department, ROUND(SUM(monthly_cost) / (SELECT SUM(monthly_cost) FROM employees), 4) AS cost_share FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY department ASC

cases.question: 已完成订单的支付记录里，各支付状态分别有多少笔
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.status, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments p JOIN enterprise_orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY p.status ASC

cases.question: 各商品类别的平均毛利（售价减成本）是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(list_price - cost), 2) AS avg_margin FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category ASC

cases.question: 库存低于补货点的商品仓库组合占比是多少（用 0 到 1 的小数表示）
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN available_qty < reorder_point THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS alert_share FROM inventory

cases.question: 各客户等级带来的订单总额是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.level, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total FROM enterprise_customers c JOIN enterprise_orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY c.level ASC

cases.question: 各渠道已完成订单的客单价是多少
cases.gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(total_amount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM enterprise_orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel ASC
